text:
Nell (People Ops): Heads-up: Luca's birthday is Friday June 18. Quick poll: espresso trolley at 11:00 or desk plants + card at 2pm? low-key option preferred. vote with emoji :tada:
Luca: Either is fine, honestly. I love caffeine but plants are very welcome too :)
Hannah: Espresso trolley please :coffee: remote folks can still drop a message.
Rory: Plant + card. last year's cake left a sugar coma :grimacing:
Diego: I'm remote that day, can Venmo $5 for a plant if that's the plan.
Sana: Trolley is fun but noisy. plant seems quieter and longer-lived.
hr-bot: Note: outside vendors (trolley) need facilities approval 48h in advance. Also avoid helium balloons.
Maya: We could do both if people chip in? trolley in AM and small desk succulents in PM. optional contributions only.
Jon: I'm good with plant only to keep it simple. will sign the card.
Ivy: Sent $5 to the plant pool (https://pay.example/giftpool/luca).
Nell (People Ops): Plan update: small desk succulents + card at 2pm. Suggested contribution $5; calendar invite "Luca - drop by" 1:55-2:10. If anyone strongly prefers trolley, DM me and we'll see if facilities okays it.
Luca: Thank you all! small plant sounds perfect, no singing required :smile:
Hannah: RSVP: popping by at 2.
Nell (People Ops): Card will be on the kitchen counter. I'll post the pool link and confirm plant pickup time tomorrow. Thanks team :sparkles:
